test_objective: Check that you can retrieve the temporal evolution of the last N instances of entity attributes
keywords: Retrieve the temporal evolution of the last N instances of entity attributes

test_cases.name: 020_05_01 Retrieve Some Instances
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve the temporal evolution of the last N instances of entity attributes
test_cases.template: Retrieve the temporal evolution of the last N instances of entity attributes
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Response Body containing EntityTemporal element containing attribute instances in the time range specified by the NGSI-LD temporal query:
            * the payload is defined in the file set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-020-05-01-expectation.jsonld'
            * the id was changed to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}'
            * response body to be checked set to '${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{temporal_entity_representation_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Temporal Representation of Entity and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: lastN set to '10' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
